ns2:course.label: Formal Logic and Philosophy
ns2:course.description: Techniques and results of symbolic logic, with special attention to topics of philosophical importance. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PHIL 202, graduate standing, or consent of instructor.
